_about: Named centralized-exchange accounts on NEAR mainnet for PREREG H1b/H1c (phase 1a, lane h1b-exchange). Built 2026-11-06 before any H1b/H1c flow query ran. Only accounts with a citable source are listed; nothing is inferred from account names alone. These are reserve (hot/cold) wallets, not per-user deposit addresses; deposit addresses are added by the sweep-clustering rule in sql_a/sql_c (tier 2/3), not here.
